---
title: "Experiment registry"
---

Every experiment registers here **before it runs** — no post-hoc entries.
Rendered from [`experiments/registry.yaml`](https://github.com/dbetebenner/dbetebenner-dissertation/blob/main/experiments/registry.yaml)
at publish time; the rules live in the
[registry protocol](experiments/registry-protocol.md).

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
reg <- yaml::read_yaml("../experiments/registry.yaml")$experiments
if (length(reg) == 0) {
  cat("*No experiments registered yet. The first registrations arrive with",
      "M4's benchmark plan — baselines vs copula families on the frozen",
      "splits, primary metric held-out log-loss.*\n")
} else {
  cat("| Run | Question | Dataset | Primary metric | Status |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n")
  for (e in reg) {
    cat(sprintf("| `%s` | %s | `%s` | `%s` | **%s** |\n",
                e$run_id, e$research_question, e$dataset_id,
                e$metrics$primary, e$status))
  }
}
```
